bagPolicy.summary: Bridgestone Arena discourages bringing bags to events for safety and speed of entry. Bags larger than 12”x12”x6” are prohibited, while smaller bags are subject to screening.
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions may be made for medical needs and diaper bags.

parking.note: Parking is available at multiple locations around Bridgestone Arena, including Fifth + Broadway Garage, 222 2nd Ave Garage, and Nashville Yards Garages. Prices vary, with some options available for purchase online or upon entry.
lots: First Baptist Church of Nashville Parking
Fifth Ave. of the Arts Garage

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Bridgestone Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Bridgestone Arena offers a variety of dining options including the BetMGM Sports Lounge, which features Smashburger, Crispy Salmon, and hand-crafted cocktails. Pete & Terry's Tavern provides craft beer and a pet-friendly atmosphere. Both venues offer a lively environment with sports programming.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: ADA accessible venue. Wheelchair seating, elevators, and ramps throughout. Contact box office for accessible seating.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry policy varies, check your specific event.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office open event days from 1:00 PM. Will call requires photo ID, available 2 hrs before event. Cashless venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Located at 501 Broadway, Nashville. Doors open 90 mins to 2 hrs before showtime.
